full_judgment: 2. Short facts relevant for the purpose of the case are that, the petitioners as complainants instituted a suit in the court of the Senior Assistant Judge, Jamalpur being Other Class Suit No. 184 of 1987, praying for declaration of title and recovery of khas possession in the suit property and eventually obtained an ex parte decree therein on 18-4-98. Thereafter, the defendant-opposite parties filed an application under Order 9 rule 13 of the Code of Civil Procedure for setting aside the ex parte decree whereupon Miscellaneous Case No. 18 of 1992 was started but the said Miscellaneous Case was ultimately dismissed on contest. Against the aforesaid order of dismissal the defendant opposite parties took an appeal before the District Judge, Jamalpur being Miscellaneous Appeal No. 22 of 1993, and the said appeal was also dismissed on 8-3-95. Thereafter the plaintiff petitioner started Other Class Execution Case No. 10 of 1990 and in execution of the decree obtained delivery of possession in the suit property through the Court on 15-10-96 after evicting the defendants therefrom. Thereafter, on 26-11-96 the plaintiff petitioners filed an application before the Executing Court in Other Class Execution Case No. 10 of 1990 under section 151 of the Code of Civil Procedure for amendment of the schedule of the plaint by way of correcting the ROR plot numbers and a corresponding amendment of the application for execution of the decree on the ground that due to inadvertence at the time of drafting the plaint, for plot No. 2892 in place of 6892 and ROR, plot No. 2896 in place of 8696 were wrongly inserted and these were required to be corrected in the interest of justice.
